create_WorkflowConfig: create a WorkflowConfig dataclass instance with device, dataset, fg_model, bg_model, trainer, and contraction fields
configure_WorkflowConfig_contraction: configure the WorkflowConfig contraction field to use none, ndc, or mipnerf ray contraction scheme
configure_WorkflowConfig_data_sources: configure the WorkflowConfig data_sources dict to map source names to their parameter dictionaries
configure_WorkflowConfig_models: configure the WorkflowConfig fg_model and bg_model fields with ModelConfig instances for foreground and background models
configure_WorkflowConfig_trainer: configure the WorkflowConfig trainer field with an ObjectConfig specifying the trainer name and parameters
